title: Ludo's sprite animation - Help
author: skat325is
selftext:
Anyone have any tips on prompts for 2D sprite walking south/down animations ?   
I keep getting the animation walking towards the camera and not "walking on the same place".... don't really wanna keep wasting tokens trying to get it right. I got lucky on the first character with this prompt:  
"Walking animation on the same place, not towards the camera, front view." But now im on the second character and it's being stubborn.

  
Thanks in advance.

comments.author: Quind1
comments.body: I would recommend reaching out in their Discord.

comments.author: melonboy55
comments.body: Working on a tool to fix this rn

comments.author: Water_Confident
comments.body: We have a similar product at Makko.AI and are giving out free credits daily all month, we’d love your feedback!

replies.author: skat325is
replies.body: any tips on north animations? I keep getting frontal animations..

replies.author: Water_Confident
replies.body: Ask it for “back view” or “rear view” :)

replies.author: skat325is
replies.body:
that worked great
any tips on preventing the character to "grow" in size as the animation plays? its like zooming in to the camera

also whats the manifest option for?

replies.author: Water_Confident
replies.body:
Regarding the camera zoom, if you ask it to maintain distance and perspective consistently that should work. Also, the manifest option is for creating a JSON that you can then write into any game you're working on by navigating to the ai assistant for that game, clicking on the "assets" icon, and then the elipses on the character you want to add to the game and click "add to game" then you can tell the AI assistant to put that character in whatever game you're building with us :).

My email is [tony@makko.ai](mailto:tony@makko.ai) if you ever want to reach out with questions. A group of us hang out in discord almost 18 hours/day vibe coding games and playing Fellowship (Arc Raiders soon :)).
